name: perl-parallel-iterator
description: This tool provides a simple interface to parallelize iterative tasks in Perl by managing a pool of worker processes. Use when user asks to parallelize loops or map calls, manage worker concurrency, or process large datasets in batches.
overview: The `perl-parallel-iterator` skill provides guidance on using the `Parallel::Iterator` library to parallelize iterative tasks. Unlike complex fork-management systems, this tool provides a simple "iterate" function that replaces standard loops or `map` calls, automatically managing a pool of worker processes to handle items in parallel.
